follow_on.gate: If engine screen clears, freeze exact terminal binary identities before real-PTY series. Require simultaneous one-sided alpha=.05/6 order-statistic median lower bounds candidate/control >.98 ASCII and all other controls, >1.03 Unicode. All six candidate/Ghostty paired medians >1 and Holm-corrected six-workload sign p<.05 with positive direction. If primary fails stop, no rescue replication. If passes separately frozen replication required. Other user-facing metrics still unbound.

stop: If engine screen fails, restore engine.rs and exact selected terminal executable remains unchanged; retain independent parser boundary regression and source patch. No search over variants in this series.
